notes.title: Retiring From Steam!
notes.notes: [p][u][b]Q&A 2025[/b][/u][/p][olist][*][p][b]Why is Tiny Tank no longer available on Steam?[/b][/p][p align="start"]The game is no longer available for download through Steam and other platforms. This is be due to internal decisions regarding the game's future or platform policies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Will I be able to still keep the game and play it?[/b][/p][p align="start"]Yes, if you already own Tiny Tank, you will be able to keep your version of the game and continue playing it without any issues. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Any further updates or plans on this game?[/b][/p][p align="start"]Future updates for Tiny Tank will be small and mostly focused on fixes. There are currently no plans for major new content or expansions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]What is the future for gaming with this company?[/b][/p][p align="start"]We are currently developing a new project that will be revealed soon through Steam or on our social media platforms.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where can I find more information?[/b][/p][p align="start"]More information will be shared through Steam and our official social media platforms. Stay tuned for announcements and updates.[/p][/*][/olist][p][u][b]Recap[/b][/u][/p][p]Tiny tank will no longer be available for download, all previous owners of the game/DLC will keep their copies. Any future updates available for the game will be small bug fixes and only apply to the latest version of the product. [/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Future Plans[/b][/u][/p][p]Currently developing a horror 2v6 hide n seek game we have dinosaurs! News on this will be revealed soon through our official discord server. (Link once available)[/p][p][/p]
